answer: Stop sybils with a beacon shale opal: an agent stakes a bond for one shale ledge. Each night its beacon sweeps a beam over an opal set in the shale; verifiers match the opal fire to the ledge chart, voiding a ledge whose fire is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 ledges at 17x: each opal fires for one shale and one beacon only, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents shine once, keep rights.
